BiblicalUsage: Hararite means a man from the hill country, and the name marks three of David's mighty men. In 1 Chronicles 11:34 Jonathan the son of Shage is called a Hararite, in 2 Samuel 23:11 Shammah the son of Agee defends a field of lentils alone, and in 2 Samuel 23:33 another Hararite stands in the same honoured list.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the list is the point: God keeps the names of men who stood their ground, even when all we know about them is where they came from.
